draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 134th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 28 at DE. He went 61st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (134th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Eli Harold. Testing standouts: broad jump (88th percentile). College production: 5 sacks in 2021, 19th of 28 DEs in his class with stats.
